items.name: SNG Barratt
items.sells: New Jaguar parts, its own XK8 catalogue PDF, Bell sports exhaust, Brembo, Polybush, EBC, Adamesh mesh, trim
items.note: First call for part numbers. Bridgnorth head office, plus Manchester NH, Charney-les-Macon and Oisterwijk branches. Catalogue is a free X100 parts reference.

items.name: David Manners
items.sells: Jaguar and Daimler car parts
items.note: www.davidmanners.co.uk redirects here. X100 stock depth not checked, so ring with part numbers.

items.name: British Parts UK
items.sells: X100 catalogue with live ex-VAT prices: timing kits, poly and rebuild kits, Bilstein, EBC, braided hoses, gearbox service parts
items.note: Best public X100 price list found. Prices shown + VAT by default. Enter your VIN at checkout so staff can check fit. Telephone 01438 354810 on site.

items.name: Rimmer Bros
items.sells: British car parts including Jaguar V8 timing kits such as RJ1047
items.note: RJ1047 is listed against X308, so confirm fit for X100. Worth a price check, not a first stop for X100.

items.name: XK8 Parts (DCR AutoParts)
items.sells: Independent X100 and X150 parts, used parts, books, tool hire, worldwide mail order
items.note: Run by Dave Roche, who wrote the GROWLER timing article. Based in Drumnadrochit, Inverness-shire. Tool hire is the useful bit for a DIY timing job.

items.name: Jaguar Spares North East
items.sells: Jaguar spares including a full X100 4.0 timing chain and tensioner kit
items.note: Kit listing: 2 top and 2 lower tensioners, 2 primary and 2 secondary chains, 4 guides, 8 bolts, to engine 0108122359.

items.name: Ashwood Jag Parts
items.sells: Jaguar parts and accessories, including C2A1511 secondary tensioner
items.note: Useful for individual tensioners.

items.name: Polybush
items.sells: Polyurethane bushes for XK8/XK8R, including a 12-bush front kit
items.note: Maker. Prices shown inc VAT.

items.name: Powerflex
items.sells: Polyurethane bushes by position for X100, Road and Black series
items.note: Maker. Buy only the positions you need.

items.name: Goodridge
items.sells: Braided brake hose kits, X100 kit 38101
items.note: UK price not found.

gaps: Web search budget ran out, so no further vendor hunting was possible. A proper list of X100-focused UK independent garages still needs a phone round or club advice.

KWE (Knowles Wilkins Engineering), named by owners as a well known UK Jaguar specialist: the kwecars.com domain redirected automated checks to a gambling site on 1 Nov 2026, so it is left out and should not be followed until its real address is confirmed.

XKs Unlimited: www.xks.com returned a bare 'xks.pro' page on 1 Nov 2026, so it is left out until the current site is confirmed. Welsh Enterprises: www.welshent.com answered HTTP 307 to automated checks and could not be read, so it is left out.

Candidates tried with no working URL on the addresses guessed: Chiltern of Bovingdon, P&K Thornton (Lambley, Nottingham, covered by Classic & Sports Car but post-war classic focus), Suffolk & Turley, Aldridge Trimming, Robbins, Double S Exhausts, Twyford Moors, Jagbits UK, jaguar-daimler-club.de. Not a claim that those firms have closed.
International Jaguar XK Club (xkclub.com) covers XK 120, 140 and 150 only, so it was left out.
bellautoservices.co.uk is a York 4x4 specialist, not the Bell exhaust maker, so it is excluded. No separate Bell exhaust site was confirmed. Buy Bell through SNG.
No EU X100 specialist garage was verified. German search found no reliable names.

Several sites refused automated checks on 1 Nov 2026 (HTTP 403 or 429): Paramount, Adamesh, Eurojag, GT2i, EBC, Demon Tweeks, Autobutler, Jaguar Owners Club, xkec.co.uk. Goodridge answered 429 once and 200 later. All other listed URLs returned 200.
